Name: Mayor's Lucky Purple Shorts Hats
Author: PakRT
Description:
Miss that lucky purple shorts that you have returned to Lewis too soon and realised that you have missed the meme opportunity? Worry not, for this mod will bring back that glorious purple shorts as a wearable hat so that you can shame and terrorise Lewis and Marnie in the public !
[i]
(* ps:they don't actually seem to be aware of your beautiful hat*)
[/i]
You need SMAPI and Content Patcher for this mod. The mod release has two versions:
[list]
[*]1.2 version: Replaces polkadot bow
[*]1.3 version: Replaces cone hat

[/list]

Downloads.Description: Compatibles with SDV 1.2+. Replaces the Polkadot Bow
